jimmyhuang2002-hermes-backup-recovery-ro.description: Back up, verify, and restore a long-running Hermes deployment's state (memory, learned skills, config, chat history). Use when the user asks to protect against data loss, set up scheduled encrypted backups, run a restore drill, check whether backups are healthy, or recover after a crash or disk failure. Designed for always-on agents where losing state is not acceptable. Provider- and hardware-agnostic.
